content.short: SafeSwap is a decentralized atomic swap bridge for native tokens, enabling transfers across multiple chains.
content.description: SafeSwap is an atomic swapping platform designed to improve interoperability, scalability, and security for cross-chain token transfers. It lets developers move native tokens across multiple chains, expanding reach and unlocking access to diverse blockchain features without relying on wrapped tokens. The Atomic Swap protocol uses a smart locking and unlocking mechanism on the participating chains, enabling peer-to-peer swaps that occur directly between users' wallets with no intermediaries.
